ruling.recommended_action: Refund $8.58 (excess distance fare) to the rider's original payment method; send the driver a notification-duty reminder and log the notification failure on his route-compliance record (no formal warning, first such incident).
ruling.reasoning:
Route deviation, no safety content in the complaint, driver statement or chat — screened, nothing found.

Deviation: actual 29.98 km vs recommended 24.445 km = 5.54 km, well over the 1 km tolerance (RD-1). Per-km distance fare = 42.27 / 29.98 = $1.41/km. No traffic justification exists for the detoured part of the recommended route: the only speed-band events are a band-2 (10–19 km/h) window on AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY — which the actual trip drove anyway — and a band-7 event on CENTRAL EXPRESSWAY, which the recommended route also uses; traffic_conditions is empty. So RD-2 "no traffic reason" applies: refund excess distance fare, record a driver violation.

Consent check (RD-5 / RD-3): the driver asked at 18:45:20 "Jam ahead, shall I take another way?"; the rider replied at 18:46:00 "可以，不要走 Clementi Avenue 2" — a qualified yes (general consent to another way, but off Clementi Avenue 2). Under RD-5 this covers only segments that did not drive Clementi Avenue 2. The segment from ~18:45 to ~18:51.75 (AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY → CLEMENTI WEST STREET 1 → WEST COAST ROAD) did not use Clementi Avenue 2, so the rider's consent exempts it: ~2.49 km (11.16 min at speeds consistent with the low-speed band; consistent with the GPS gap at 18:45:15, which falls in this stretch). The remaining ~3.05 km — the jog via Clementi Road / Kent Ridge Crescent / Arts Link / Kent Ridge Drive / Pasir Panjang Road plus the reversed SOUTH BUONA VISTA ROAD loop (18:51:45–19:00:30) rejoining AYE, and the later Sheares Avenue detour (19:09:45–19:11:00) — is not covered by the rider's words: it drove a route she never agreed to in place of the expressway, and no traffic reason existed. Refundable km = 5.54 − 2.49 = 3.05 km → 3.05 × $1.41 = $8.58. Tolls (nil), time fare and surge are not refunded (RD-2). Driver's verbally-claimed "kept off one road" consent is a claim, not consent (RD-5).

Amount $8.58 is under $10, so the system ruling is final (TH-1 / TH-2, per DISP-001). Precedent DISP-2026-0089 (uninformed reroute) is aligned. No repeat driver deviation in the last 90 days, so no RD-6 flag.

segment_findings.reason: Rider's 18:46:00 "可以，不要走 Clementi Avenue 2" gave a qualified general consent to an alternative way; this stretch (AYE → Clementi West Street 1 → West Coast Road, ~18:45–18:51.75, ~2.49 km) did not drive the excluded road, so it is covered and not a deviation (RD-3/RD-5). The road-name words provided (Clementi Avenue 2) are absent from the driven roads, confirming the exclusion was honoured here.

The 18:51:45–19:00:30 jog via Clementi Road / Kent Ridge Crescent / Arts Link / Kent Ridge Drive / Pasir Panjang Road and the reversed South Buona Vista Road loop (~2.65 km) goes a way the rider never named; her qualified yes only covered 'another way' that avoided Clementi Avenue 2 and cannot stretch to this long detour off the expressway. No traffic reason on the replaced part of the recommended route (RD-4 not met) and no notice or consent (RD-5). Counts as deviation (RD-2).

The 19:09:45–19:11:00 Sheares Avenue / East Coast Parkway approach (~0.40 km) replaces the recommended Marina Boulevard / Temasek Boulevard tail; no rider message and no traffic event covers it (RD-5). Counts as deviation (RD-2).

element_findings.reason: traffic_conditions is empty. The AYE band-2 window (speed_band 2, 18:25:45–18:59:15) lies on the replaced stretch but the actual trip drove that same AYE stretch, and the CENTRAL EXPRESSWAY band-7 window (10–19 km/h) is on a road the recommended route also uses; under RD-4 these are not traffic events, and the detour offers no justification (and no improvement) for those stretches.

Rider's 18:46:00 message is a qualified yes: general agreement to another way but expressly excluding Clementi Avenue 2. Consent exists for the alternative-way segment that kept off Clementi Avenue 2; it does not cover the segments driven a way she did not name.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims the rider allowed 'another way as long as I kept off one road'. The chat confirms only a qualified yes excluding Clementi Avenue 2, which does not authorise the long detour via Clementi Road / Pasir Panjang Road / South Buona Vista Road and Sheares Avenue that the telemetry shows; a claimed verbal agreement is not consent under RD-5.
